title: Grateful Dead Live at Curtis Hixon Convention Hall on 1973-12-18
lineage: Reel master > cassette > DAT > CDR (unknown gens) > Undisclosed Noise Reduction processsing step? > ? > SHN

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a wildly exploratory 1973 show featuring a smoking China>Rider jam and a unique mid‑tempo Mind Left Body masterpiece.
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave about the band's on‑fire playing, calling out the tight China > Rider transition, a rare mid‑tempo Mind Left Body jam, and fiery Dark Star, Eyes, Wharf Rats and The Greatest Story. The soundboard source is praised for its clarity with only a brief tape‑flip glitch in Wharf Rat, making the recording both vivid and highly listenable.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers gave 4–5 stars and highlighted exceptional musical moments with only minor recording glitches; average rating ~4.1 adjusted upward for strong show quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, balanced soundboard capture; a few glitches noted (tape flip on Wharf Rat) but overall excellent fidelity and mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert flows organically with a tight first‑set energy and an exploratory second set that builds into intense, jazz‑fusion jams, maintaining momentum throughout.

band_member_comments.Phil: Phil delivers powerful bomb bursts and teases The Other One fiercely after the MLB jam.
